notes:
STATUS: Closed-lost to Together (primary). Also evaluated Fireworks and Replicate.

Timeline / key activities:
- 2024-08-15: Lead created (inbound via partner). Engineering contact: Aaron Kim (lead SW).
- 2024-09-02: Discovery call — Jordan (AE) + Priya (SE). Requirements: real-time inference for robotics fleet, target p99 <50ms, sustained 400-600 req/s, strong data residency + KMS/HSM requirement. Interested in on-prem or VPC.
- 2024-09-20: Arch workshop; demonstrated Redwood Dedicated and private control plane. Positive reactions to runtime optimizations; ops worried about HSM integration.
- 2024-10-03: Security deep-dive (linked ff_2024-10-03_Valence_disccall). Main items: SAML attribute mapping mismatch with their IdP, need for HSM attestation (FIPS), audit log retention 7 years.
- 2024-10-30: POC kickoff (2-week). POC used quantized model (xyz-7b); single-site latency targets met in lab, but burst throughput stability issues surfaced. We proposed batching + KV-cache config; team requested on-prem image for further testing.
- 2024-11-15: Procurement inquiry for fixed-price pilot. Competitors responded: Together offered 1-year pilot with dedicated infra discount, Fireworks promised an on-prem appliance trial, Replicate offered lower per-call pricing for embeddings/telemetry.
- 2024-11-21: Security escalated additional questionnaire (linked ff_2024-11-21_security_review). Delay while waiting for KMS/HSM attestation and ISO docs.
- 2024-12-05: Communication window — account goes quiet. Follow-ups unanswered for 3 weeks.
- 2024-12-18: Heard via partner that vendor selection favored Together — cited better price & guaranteed throughput SLA on pilot.
- 2025-01-09: Final closure call. CTO quote: "We liked Redwood's tech, but Together gave us a lower-cost pilot + SLA we couldn't ignore. Also, our infra lead left — no one to champion the integration right now."

Why we lost / current blockers:
- Competitive pricing: Together's pilot + discount reduced near-term TCO vs our estimate (~$300k ARR).
- Security blockers: Customer required HSM/KMS attestation and specific SAML mapping behavior; procurement paused while these were unresolved.
- Organizational: key internal champion (infra lead) exited, leaving no owner to drive procurement — stalled.
- Budget: governance imposed a budget freeze for new vendor commitments until Q2.

Follow-ups / next steps (internal):
- Mark as Closed-lost (source: Together). Add to "competitor-wins" tracker.
- Share POC telemetry and tuning notes with AMG (runtime team) — batching recommendations may help future upsell.
- Keep security artifacts (drive:/security/valence-scan-responses-2024.xlsx) for reference; flag HSM attestation gap for roadmap/integration planning.
- Re-engage in Q2-2025 if budget re-opens or if Together under-delivers on SLA.
